toolbarLabel.title: Duck.ai actions
toolbarLabel.note: Accessible name of the toolbar that appears above text the user selects on a web page.

ask.title: Ask Duck.ai…
ask.note: Toolbar button on selected text. Opens Duck.ai in the sidebar with the selected text attached, so the user can type a question about it.

more.title: More Duck.ai actions
more.note: Accessible name of the toolbar's '…' button, which opens a menu of further actions and options.

hideTools.title: Hide selection tools
hideTools.note: Menu item in the selected-text toolbar. Turns the toolbar off on every page until it is turned back on in AI Settings.

openSettings.title: Open AI Settings
openSettings.note: Menu item in the selected-text toolbar. Opens the browser's AI Settings page.

sent.title: Sent to Duck.ai
sent.note: Brief confirmation shown in the selected-text toolbar after an action has been sent to the Duck.ai sidebar.
